heading: Extension of protections to dependents
lead: Upon application to a court, a dependent of a servicemember is entitled to the protections of this subchapter if the dependent’s ability to comply with a lease, contract, bailment, or other obligation is materially affected by reason of the servicemember’s military service.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 538 of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section applicable to any case not final before Dec. 19, 2003, see section 3 of Pub. L. 108–189, set out as a note under section 3901 of this title.
